native_payload.body_markdown:
**[US midterms: Capital Chronicle on the result that could surprise markets](https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/us-midterms-capital-chronicle-on)**

A Democratic sweep leads expectations in Capital Chronicle's dated preview. Republican control, a split Congress or a slow count could change the market response.

**[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission plans November 9 data roundtable](https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/us-securities-and-exchange-commission)**

The SEC plans a public discussion of machine-understandable data and Super Intelligence. Readers can follow the webcast and listen for concrete evidence of use, risks and costs.

**[September 2026 jobs: private gains beneath a weak headline](https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/september-2026-jobs-private-gains)**

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics initially reported 29,000 more September payroll jobs. Private gains offset government losses; earnings growth softened.

Analysis, not financial advice.
